title: Are there any Indian/Pakistani community in Chesham?
key_point: Harrow Asian families move to Chesham for grammar schools; first question is whether an Indian/Pakistani community and mosque exist.

title: Can we as an Asian family move to a rural area?
key_point: Indian-heritage Londoners weigh bigger cheaper house against racism risk; minority buyers add safety/acceptance to space, schools, transport checklist.

title: HBS, Woodford or Chelmsford? Grammar school dilemma!
key_point: Redbridge families target Woodford/HBS/Chelmsford grammars; Woodford described as ~90% Asian, pupils commuting from Redbridge.

title: Why white children are not getting into grammar schools
key_point: North London grammar: ~3,000 applicants for 104 places, one white British admit; South Asian tutoring culture drives grammar-catchment demand.

title: Buying A House In Uk
key_point: Nigeria-based saver with N50m; thread warns of scams, advises buying outside London, registered agents, RICS survey, no intermediaries.

title: Living In The UK: Property, Mortgage And Related (page 12)
key_point: Visa-holder mortgages (5-10% deposit), leasehold service-charge fears, flat-to-buy-to-let remortgage ladder among Nigerian diaspora.

title: Relocating To Uk (page 3)
key_point: Newcomers seek 'own people'; after Peckham regeneration Nigerians moved to Woolwich, Plumstead, Abbey Wood, Thamesmead, Essex.

title: Gifted Deposit from abroad
key_point: Deposit gifted from father in India; one solicitor demanded six months in UK account, others accept with source-of-funds evidence.

title: Restriction on certain type of foods in the rental agreement (AST)
key_point: Central London landlord seeks curry-cooking ban; replies call it unenforceable, likely indirect race discrimination; some advise tenant screening.

title: Housing changes of immigrants and their descendants using long-term census panel data from England and Wales
key_point: ONS LS 1971-2011: Indian and Pakistani descendants more likely than natives to enter home ownership; first generation prioritise community.

title: Understanding differences in residential location preferences between ownership and renting: a case study of London
publisher: Journal of Transport Geography (Haque, Choudhury, Hess)
key_point: London mixed-logit: owners and renters both value higher same-ethnic share, school quality, jobs access; dislike crime.

title: Islamic Home Finance in the UK: A Partial Least Square Structural Equation Modelling Approach
key_point: Only ~2,500-3,000 UK Islamic mortgages yearly; brokers rate authenticity of Sharia compliance as key driver, affordability insignificant.

title: Amar Bari, Amar Jibon [My Home, My Life]: Developing Suitable Living Environments for Bangladeshi Elders (four East London boroughs)
key_point: 83% of 76 Bangladeshi elders live multigenerationally; 'functional overcrowding'; mosques, halal shops, family proximity define neighbourhood choice.

title: London property gains benefit from India's overseas investment rules
key_point: India's $250k/person remittance limit lets families send ~$1m/yr; 30% of Black Brick enquiries from resident Indians, ~GBP1m, BTL.

title: A pick of the best homes for multi-generational living
key_point: Rising multigenerational households per census; buyers seek annexes, converted lofts, self-contained floors, second living rooms.

title: Indian buyers pile in to London's property market on the hunt for vastu-compliant homes
key_point: Buying agent: around half of Indian (esp. NRI) buyers seek vastu-compliant homes; a deal-breaker, hard to find in existing stock.

title: Home ownership (Ethnicity facts and figures)
key_point: Ownership: White British 70%, Indian 68%, Pakistani 55%, Bangladeshi 37%, Black Caribbean 31%, Black African 22%.

title: Overcrowded households (Ethnicity facts and figures)
key_point: Overcrowding: Bangladeshi 18%, Black African 16%, Pakistani 14%, Indian 6%, White British 2%; London 11% for non-White-British.

title: Long read - A cycle of inequality: minority ethnic renters' experiences of discrimination
key_point: Minority renters refused tenancy 12.5% vs 6.3%; white profiles 36% more positive replies; 60% of Asian renters struggle with rent.

title: Right to Rent: entrenching discrimination in the private rented sector
key_point: 24% of landlords think they cannot rent to non-UK passport holders; white-sounding names get 25% more replies than South Asian names.

title: Indian buyers lead Asian investment in London's property market
key_point: Indians 40% of Asian buyers' London purchases Q1 2024; Asian buyers 11% of London purchases (6% in 2016).

title: For the South Asian community, the housing market is tearing people away from their tight-knit family culture in London
key_point: South Asian second generation priced out of family clusters; trade-off bigger homes outside London vs weekly family ties; racism limits relocation.
